author: TED
description:
Finance doesn't have to feel like a foreign language. Wall Street trader-turned-financial educator Vivian Tu @YourRichBFF helps millions of people make sense of money, breaking down complex concepts into everyday terms you can understand. She shares how she broke free from the stress of living paycheck to paycheck — and explores how we can shift power structures to give everyone a real shot at building wealth. (Recorded at TEDNext 2025 on November 10, 2025)
